meta.name: Lupin The 3rd
meta.description: Interpol Inspector Zenigata begins a world-wide hunt for the infamous thief Arsène Lupin III, who, with his cavalcade of collaborators infiltrate a highly secured fortress-like safe named the 'Ark of Navarone' to claim the "Crimson Heart of Cleopatra".
meta.slogan: Eyes on the world's most beautiful prize.
